title: A calcium–phosphate spline surface does not establish incremental PTH prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: A fixed nonlinear calcium-phosphate surface did not establish incremental cross-cycle PTH prediction beyond flexible standard measures, product and a low-calcium/high-phosphate hinge: target MSE gain 0.00000497 log-PTH-squared units, joint PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.00000841, 0.00001881]. Frozen development used 4,358 adults in 2003–2004 and evaluation used 4,394 separately sampled adults in 2005–2006. Temporal within-program validation, not external clinical validation; an exploratory negative representation test, not equivalence.
